children: Worthington Steel entered into a Domination and Profit and Loss Transfer Agreement with Kloeckner to assume control and integrate earnings. Upon effectiveness, Worthington Steel may direct Kloeckner's management, receive its annual profits, and cover losses, subject to German law. Outside shareholders may elect €11.00 per share in cash or a recurring €0.67 gross (€0.66 net) annual payment per share. The agreement requires shareholder approvals and commercial register entry, with effectiveness no earlier than Jan 1, 2027; appraisal proceedings could raise compensation but will not delay registration.
: Domination and Profit and Loss Transfer Agreement (DPLTA)
: Establish control and integrate Kloeckner's profits and losses

title: Worthington Steel Moves to Control Kloeckner With DPLTA, Offering €11.00 Per Share
